items.rationale: The permanently wired unit is insured under 4.2.3, and at about seven metres from the hob it is outside the five-metre exclusion in 2.3.10(c). Sections 2.3.3 and 7.1.9 support €1,250 gross for equivalent equipment alone; no scheduled deductible amount is supplied.

Section 2.3.10(c) excludes surge damage to climate-control equipment within five metres of a cooking appliance, and no kitchen climate endorsement is in force. The €850 estimate is conditional only; the expected payment is zero.

Section 7.1.9(c) expressly covers the labour to remove the damaged unit, fit the replacement, connect it and commission it. Allow €450 gross for standard installation labour, excluding any separate general wiring inspection.
Under 7.1.11, installation follows the principal item, which is excluded by 2.3.10(c). The €400 estimate is a conditional labour benchmark, not a payable amount.

Section 7.1.9(b) covers a necessary equivalent support when the original is damaged or cannot be reused. The old console was scorched and unusable, so allow €135 gross for the replacement stand, excluding labour already captured in line 3.

Sections 7.1.11–7.1.12 cover ordinary freight only in the proportion attributable to the living-room unit. With no weight- or volume-based billing shown, allocate €120 gross by estimated equipment value: €120 × €1,250 ÷ (€1,250 + €850) ≈ €71, subject to substantiation.
